items.explanation: “give in” = to finally agree to something after refusing. Full sentence: The children kept asking for ice cream until their dad decided to give in.

items.question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
Some drivers think they can ___ parking anywhere they like.
items.meaningVi: thoát tội, làm sai mà không bị phạt
items.explanation: “get away with” = to do something wrong without being punished. Full sentence: Some drivers think they can get away with parking anywhere they like.

items.question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
If you don't ___ for work on time, you'll lose your job.
items.explanation: “show up” = to arrive somewhere, especially when people are waiting. Full sentence: If you don't show up for work on time, you'll lose your job.

items.question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
If you ___ any interesting articles about climate change, please send them to me.
items.explanation: “come across” = to find or meet something by chance. Full sentence: If you come across any interesting articles about climate change, please send them to me.
